$comment: The one file that customizes pi-lifeos. Edit, then run: bun ~/Projects/toolbelt/pi-lifeos/build.ts (or /lifeos-rebuild inside pi), then /reload.

stockSkills.$comment: Skills pi auto-discovers in ~/.agents/skills (the stock LifeOS set). All are hidden except these, to save context on local models. Add a folder name here to bring one back.

model.$comment: Default model pi boots on. Switch any session with Ctrl+P or /model. jev/auto: extensions/jev-router.ts (ISA C14-C16).

router.$comment: jev/auto routing (ISA C15-C17). Jev gets the user prompt alone, truncated (A5). build/agent-orchestration -> buildRoute, everything else -> otherRoute. Jev failure/timeout/missing -> otherRoute, never blocks a turn (C16). Every decision appends to log/jev-router.jsonl beside this file (C17). 2026-10-14 Paul: build route uses OpenRouter Auto -- no fixed builder.
